name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing West Virginia - Buffalo WV

fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is fully chain-link perimeter-fenced (visible in 2024-10 Street View along the public road). Truck/dock operations are inside a controlled fenced perimeter; truck access is gated. Plant-property gate not directly visible in Street View (coverage stops at the public road) so the gate structure type is inferred.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth could be positively identified in imagery; main employee/visitor entrance from the public road is an open unguarded driveway opening into employee parking. Marked false / remoteGs true as a medium-confidence call - a TPS plant of this scale very likely has controlled truck check-in but the structure is not confirmable from overhead.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred - gate present, no confirmed guard shack.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large campus: a northern main powertrain building cluster and a separate large southern building cluster, plus utility/water-treatment buildings and an electrical substation on a separate east parcel.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large dedicated trailer drop yard on the north side - rows of 80+ trailers (red and silver) parked in marked stalls, separate from the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed in along the east face of the north building and the south/east faces of the south building; estimated 60+ total dock doors across the campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks and trailer staging are on the east face; the south building has its own separate dock bank - shipping and receiving run from physically distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal service roads and a large apron between the drop yard and the dock building leave ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits between the Kanawha River and farmland near the small town of Buffalo, WV; surrounded by open fields.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; the plant ships engines/transmissions by truck.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~311 acres for the fenced industrial footprint; excludes the adjacent solar farm on a separate parcel to the east.
